Resistance Endogenous friction 08 / 15

Geographic Distance

How far apart counterparties are, in space or in systems.

What it looks like Illustrative scenario

A couple in northern Ontario is separating. Custody, a lawyer in town can handle. The family's mineral claims and the outfitting business cannot be divided by anyone within six hundred kilometres. The specialist is in Toronto, with idle hours, a day's drive away and outside every local referral network.

Scenario: Six Hundred Kilometres from a Family Lawyer

How an AI intervention works AI Matching · AI Input Translation

Distance survives digital delivery because it travels with language, custom and jurisdiction. Semantic matching, on meaning rather than membership, finds the one specialist who has done this before, whatever network they sit in, and weighs logistics where delivery is physical. Input translation removes the second barrier: a voice note, a photo or a document in any language becomes structured market data, so a participant need not speak the platform's language or fill its forms to be found.

How traditional markets cope

  • Clusters, bazaars and trade fairsuntil the participants cannot travel
  • Transport infrastructureuntil the thing traded is a person's time
  • Regional broker networksuntil the need crosses the region
